reasoning_content:
The curls from the workspace returned 000 — likely because DNS for *.localhost doesn't resolve within the container, or the curl needs to use the right host. But nginx logs show earlier successful requests from 172.18.0.11 (probably the host). Let me check. The docker network gateway 172.18.0.11 is likely the host. Our commands run inside the workspace container... Actually curl exit code 6 means couldn't resolve host. Let's check /etc/hosts and DNS. Maybe *.localhost resolves to 127.0.0.1 but caddy listens on host port 443. Since we're in a separate container? Wait, the environment says "same container used for installation". Let me check.

Actually the workspace seems to be a container where docker is available (docker ps worked). curl to api.localhost fails resolution. localhost may not resolve *.localhost. Let's test with --resolve and connect to host gateway.

Let me inspect network setup.

action.command: cat /etc/hosts; echo "---resolv---"; cat /etc/resolv.conf; echo "--- curl resolve test ---"; curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "app: %{http_code}\n" --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://app.localhost/ ; curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "api: %{http_code}\n" --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://api.localhost/api/v1/ ; echo "--- docker network gw ---"; docker network inspect deployment_default 2>/dev/null | grep -i gateway
